title: Landscape
description: Sky over a wider scene. The landform stays sharp, and there is usually no defocus. The sky stays in the picture. A warm sunset line can be graded on its own without recoloring the land. When water holds a reflection of the land, that mirror is sharpened and lifted a little.
reason: The land and the sky are the picture, so neither is treated as a subject and nothing is blurred away. A sunset line is warmed by itself. A reflection in the water is made bolder than the water around it.

features.land: The landform stays sharp. A landscape usually has no defocus.
features.sky: The sky stays in the picture and can be graded on its own.
